# MIRROR_FROM_PLUGIN.md

> **Auto-generated directory — do not hand-edit.**

This directory is a mirror of the canonical agent definitions in:

```
packages/copilot-cli-plugin/agents/
```

It is regenerated by:

```bash
./scripts/regenerate-github-mirror.sh
```

**Any hand-edits made here will be overwritten on the next mirror regeneration.**

To make a permanent change to an agent definition, edit the canonical source
in `packages/copilot-cli-plugin/agents/` and then re-run the regeneration
script.

To check whether this mirror is in sync with the plugin sources, run:

```bash
./scripts/check-mirror-drift.sh
```

Exit 0 means no drift. Exit 1 means the mirror is stale and needs regeneration.
